label: inspect-feedback
argv:
from pathlib import Path
import json
b=Path("/Users/rex/Documents/ChatGPT/mobile-native-skill")
n=b/'validation/feedback-forward/neutral'
f=b/'validation/feedback-forward/neutral-targeted-v4'
for rel in ['design/reference.json','design/lock.json','source/Bridge.swift']:
 print('FILE '+rel);print((n/rel).read_text())
for rel in ['request.json','result.json','portable-scope.json','execution-coverage.json','environment-check.json','native/native-summary.json']:
 print('FILE feedback/'+rel);print((f/rel).read_text())
o=json.loads((f/'native/observation.json').read_text())
print('OBS KEYS',list(o));print('OBS SMALL FIELDS',json.dumps({k:v for k,v in o.items() if k not in ['snapshots','actions']},indent=2)[:5000])
for i,s in enumerate(o.get('snapshots',[])):
 print('SNAP',i,json.dumps({k:v for k,v in s.items() if k not in ['tree','nodes','elements','hierarchy','native_tree']})[:2000])
print('ACTION KEYS',[(i,list(a)) for i,a in enumerate(o.get('actions',[]))])
